people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Miriam
people.line: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led women in worship.

translations.web: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
translations.bsb: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the journey after you came out of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Remember what the LORD thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.
translations.asv: Remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Miriam, by the way as ye came forth out of Egypt.
